Summary of what I implemented for §5 (Transcribe/Speech):

- Copied `spec-assets/sample.wav` into `app/assets/sample.wav` (spec-assets/ itself untouched) — the `@nativescript/vite` static-copy convention bundles `app/assets/**` into the app bundle at `app/assets/...`, verified in the built `.app`.
- Added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription` to `App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`, verified present in the built Info.plist.
- Implemented `app/components/Transcribe.vue`: authorization status via `SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus()` / `requestAuthorization`, transcription via `SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` (bundle file URL, `shouldReportPartialResults = true`) and `recognitionTaskWithRequestResultHandler`, with live partial updates, a `Completed in N.N s` line on the final result, and error text surfaced in the status line on failure.

`ns build ios` succeeds, and I installed/launched the built app on the booted simulator to confirm it starts without crashing.
